consistency_issues.detail: Use case UC7 (Receive Alert Notification) has no tasks in the project plan — UC7 is mapped only to tasks T15 and T18, but UC7 represents a system-initiated action (PagerDuty sends alert) with no explicit task ownership

added_open_questions.question: Use case UC7 (Receive Alert Notification) has no explicit task in the project plan — is alert notification delivery (PagerDuty webhook trigger) covered by T15 (alert evaluation engine) or does it require a separate task?
added_open_questions.impact_if_unanswered: UC7 definition of done may be ambiguous; PagerDuty webhook delivery may not be explicitly tested or validated as a separate acceptance criterion

added_open_questions.question: Staffing capacity analysis: total effort across all tasks is 500 hours; planned duration is 12 weeks (60 work days = 360 hours at 6h/day). Total effort (500h) exceeds planned capacity (360h) by 140 hours (38.9%). How is this gap reconciled?
added_open_questions.impact_if_unanswered: Project may be under-resourced or timeline may be unrealistic; team may work overtime or scope may need to be reduced

pm_confidence_score.interpretation: PM confidence score is 65.0 because the project has well-defined requirements (HIGH input quality) and a realistic 12-week timeline with 15% buffer, but faces significant execution risks: five HIGH-scored risks (Email Service integration, PagerDuty scope, PostgreSQL performance, PO availability, Backend Developer allocation) and one HIGH-equivalent critical path risk (R11) create 1-2 week slip exposure each. Three unvalidated assumptions further reduce confidence. Staffing capacity analysis reveals 500 total effort hours against 360 planned capacity (38.9% overage), indicating either under-resourcing or timeline unrealism. Hybrid SDLC requires active stakeholder engagement and sprint discipline, dependent on PO availability (R4). Mitigation: Resolve open questions 1-5 in Week 1 discovery; validate Email Service, PagerDuty, PostgreSQL in sandbox; secure written resource commitments; reconcile staffing capacity gap before Sprint 1 kickoff.
